name: That Would Be Great
look: Bill Lumbergh, played by Gary Cole, stands in a cubicle office under fluorescent lights. He has slicked-back hair and large wire-rimmed glasses and wears a light blue shirt, red suspenders and a yellow patterned tie, resting one hand on his hip and holding a white coffee mug.
use: Passive-aggressive requests from a smug boss. The top caption starts with "Yeah, if you could..." and names an unreasonable ask, and the bottom caption finishes with "...that would be great."
slots: top caption: 'Yeah, if you could...' plus the annoying request
examples: Yeah, if you could answer emails while on vacation
Yeah, if you could stop hitting reply all
describe: boss with red suspenders and a coffee mug asking you to come in saturday
office manager with glasses and suspenders holding a mug
smug boss in a blue shirt and tie with a coffee cup
annoying boss passive aggressively asking for something
guy with glasses and slicked hair standing in a cubicle office
origin: Gary Cole as the boss Bill Lumbergh in the 1999 comedy film Office Space.
